system.description: Learn two more tools from the Hunter's Tools list — a maxed kit goes from 10 of 28 to 12 — and every tool with a target of "Self" now targets "Yourself or an ally". That second clause is the real heroic: Steel Skin, Antitoxin, Nerve Tonic, Stimulant and Medpack all become things you hand to somebody else. It does not combine with Army of One — Extra Tools changes who you may target, Army of One changes how many, and they stay separate. Adrenaline Shot works as printed on yourself or, through this, an ally: the Crisis it manufactures is real for everything keyed to Crisis status (F10). Carve-outs are per-effect, only where Crisis at full health would be degenerate — Into the Otherworld is gated on actual current HP, and is so far the only one.
